statement: theorem binary_mean_minimizer (h : List Bool) (hpos : 0 < h.length) : empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∑ t ∈ range h.length, (empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length - binaryValues h t)^2) ≤ ∑ t ∈ range h.length, (u - binaryValues h t)^2
source_assumptions: theorem binary_mean_minimizer (h : List Bool) (hpos : 0 < h.length) : empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∑ t ∈ range h.length, (empiricalMean (binaryValues h) h.length - binaryValues h t)^2) ≤ ∑ t ∈ range h.length, (u - binaryValues h t)^2
